course_name_original: Trabajo Fin de Grado (Sistemas de Telecomunicación)
prerequisites: Students must have passed all other subjects in the study plan and thus possess all necessary credits for the degree, except those corresponding to the TFG itself.

learning_outcomes.text: General presentation: adequacy to norms, legibility, writing, spelling, etc.
Logical and coherent structure in the representation of information, ideas and arguments.
Interest of the author's points of view, judgments and conclusions.
Quality of the presentation: appropriate use of means, correctness of oral expression, logical structuring, adequacy to available time, etc.
Ability to interest and capture the audience's attention.
Synthesize and integrate the competencies acquired in the teachings, related to the specific technology of the Degree.

syllabus_topics: Work within one of the topics included in the Engineering area in which the student has studied, as indicated in the objectives of each degree.

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring of the student's face-to-face activities by their academic tutor
Final document presented by the student
Public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent debate with it

assessment_rules: Assessment, both ordinary and extraordinary, is carried out through a public presentation before a tribunal of three professors from the School. Although the Final Project may be part of a joint work, the presentation must be individual, and the particular aspects or contribution of each student to the whole must be clear. The final definition of the evaluation system will be adjusted to the regulations defined in the Final Project Regulations of the School of Engineering.
